result.title: Beyond the Evidence Coherence Trap: Agent-Driven Evidence Selection for Temporally Disordered Fake News Detection
result.summary: Fake news undermines public trust and the integrity of online information ecosystems. Temporally disordered fake news is especially elusive because it rearranges factual events into a false chronology. Individual events may remain factually valid even when their temporal relations are misrepresented. When similar events involving the same entity recur, retrieval may return semantically plausible evidence from the wrong period. Consequently, independent event verification may rely on locally coherent but temporally mismatched evidence and incorrectly validate the article. We call this the \textit{evidence coherence trap}. Because existing benchmarks rarely isolate this setting, we construct ChronoFake, a source-disjoint benchmark of 30,706 articles derived from temporally anchored real events. It distinguishes temporal manipulation from valid narration, including flashbacks. To address this, we propose DelSA, a \underline{D}ocument S\underline{el}ection \underline{S}elf-Updating \underline{A}gent that iteratively refines evidence selection during training and applies a frozen rulebook for one-pass evidence selection at inference. DelSA uses an LLM to characterize candidate evidence, while a verifier-trained reranker balances local relevance against timeline consistency. Finally, the classifier compares the article-implied chronology extracted by the LLM with the evidence-derived chronology to reveal global temporal conflicts. DelSA outperforms existing methods on ChronoFake, while remaining competitive on PolitiFact and GossipCop.

AI.brief_summary: 针对「证据一致性陷阱」——时间顺序被篡改时检索到局部合理但时段错配的证据——构建 ChronoFake 基准，并提出 DelSA 智能体：LLM 刻画候选证据、验证器训练的 reranker 在局部相关性与时间线一致性间权衡，推理时用冻结规则库一次性完成选证，再由分类器比对文章隐含年表与证据年表。
AI.relevance_reason: 「训练期迭代精炼选证、推理期冻结规则一次性使用」以及局部相关性与全局一致性的显式权衡，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、证据使用与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但本文为纯文本任务，需评估其向多模态状态的迁移性。
